evidence: Plin. NH 7.198: normam autem et lībellam et tornum et clāvem Theodōrus Samius
terms.comment: A square checks right angles; a level is a lībella. Pliny, NH 7.198 credits Theodorus of Samos with inventing the square and the level; Daedalus, in the same list, invents the saw, the adze and the plumb line.

phrases.english: Theodorus invented the square and the level.

norma.html: Lewis & Short leaves the vowel unmarked, and the reader series writes norma.

sources: Traupman: Conversational Latin (printed page references in entry) · Lewis & Short: norma · Lewis & Short: libella
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours, after Pliny, NH 7.198.
